'''2017 EGP Phil Aasen DS Imperial Entanglements (2)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Phil Aasen]] at [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Phil Aasen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
